vocabulary.definition: relating to or situated on the banks of a river
vocabulary.example: The riparian countries along the Nile have vested interests in its water usage.

vocabulary.definition: the process of a liquid turning into vapor
vocabulary.example: Due to high evaporation rates, the Toshka Lakes in Egypt have shrunk over time.

vocabulary.definition: reliance on or trust in someone or something else
vocabulary.example: Egypt fears getting into a dependency on Ethiopia for its water supply.

vocabulary.definition: negotiate again in order to change the terms of an agreement
vocabulary.example: Both Egypt and Sudan refuse to renegotiate their share of Nile waters.

vocabulary.definition: the controlled distribution of scarce resources or goods
vocabulary.example: In times of drought, water rationing may become necessary to conserve resources.

vocabulary.definition: having the ability to restore health, strength, or well-being
vocabulary.example: Water reclamation projects aim to create regenerative systems for sustainable water use.
